sources.title: Countries and territories where Thai nationals may enter without a visa or receive visa on arrival
sources.publisher: Department of Consular Affairs, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Thailand
sources.officialityEvidence: The Thai MFA Consular Department's live schedule is dated 4 August 2026 and separately enumerates Ordinary Passport and Diplomatic/Official Passport arrangements.
sources.supportingExcerpt: List of Countries and Territories where Thai Nationals may enter without a visa/visa exemption.

sources.title: Djibouti eVisa service
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: Djibouti's state e-government page proves electronic issuance but publishes no Thai ordinary-passport eligibility or exemption schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois que la demande est approuvée, l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: eVisa South Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service, South Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Interior Ministry portal proves pre-travel PDF issuance but asks applicants to determine eligibility without publishing a Thai ordinary-passport result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Are you eligible for a South Sudan Visa? Start the application process by creating an account.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival service
sources.officialityEvidence: Liberia Immigration's live arrival route depends on embassy availability and therefore does not establish a passport-only Thai baseline.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.
